definition.name: Fixed public fiber compiler and non-identifying refusal

steps.name: Verify fixed ordinal diagnostic and exact inverse
Install the same source-authenticated compiler tools as the authoring job
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 180 \
  https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.1.0-bin.zip -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
echo "a17ddd85a26b6a7f5ddb71ff8b05fc5104c0202c6e64782429790c933686c806  $RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check --strict
unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
compiler_root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/latent-java-classinfo.XXXXXXXX)
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5 1195 \
  python3 -B tools/java_guest/compiler_profile_distribution.py stage \
    --root "$compiler_root" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-classinfo-compiler-product.json" \
    > "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-classinfo-compiler-path.txt"
compiler_sdk=$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-classinfo-compiler-path.txt")
test "$compiler_sdk" = "$compiler_root/work/installed/wasi-sdk"
printf 'LSF_JAVA_CLASSINFO_WASI_SDK=%s\n' "$compiler_sdk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Compile the unchanged public fiber fixture without guest execution
